question: Does the position term's contribution survive once a monotone global nonlinearity of the additive prediction is allowed?

rule.decision_statistic: D42 = per-assay R2(position+isotonic, joint backfit) - R2(isotonic), R2 = epsceil.baseline.r2_resid_var out of fold: what the position term adds once a monotone global nonlinearity of the additive prediction is allowed
rule.why_not_3_minus_2: (3 - 2) = R2(position) - R2(isotonic) compares the two terms head to head. They can explain different variance, so (3 - 2) ~ 0 does not by itself show that position IS the calibration curve, and (3 - 2) < 0 does not show that position adds nothing; the nested (4 - 2) does. (3 - 2) is reported with its interval and with the verdict the same thresholds would give it (verdict_if_decided_by_3_minus_2), but it is not the headline
rule.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap of the median over assays (position_holdout.boot_median_ci: 5000 resamples)
rule.null_of_D42: position labels permuted among the training pairs of each inner fold (isotonic still sees the real data), the same joint fit, mean over permutations, minus R2(isotonic)
rule.beats_null: share of assays whose D42 exceeds its own null by > 1e-9
rule.SUPPORTED: CI lower bound of median D42 > eps AND beats_null >= 0.75
rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: CI upper bound of median D42 < eps OR beats_null < 0.50
rule.order: SUPPORTED, then NOT_SUPPORTED, else INCONCLUSIVE (mutually exclusive)
rule.brief_statistic_reading: D32 = R2(position) - R2(isotonic): SUPPORTED if its CI lower bound > eps, NOT_SUPPORTED if its CI upper bound < eps, else INCONCLUSIVE
rule.written: before any Q2 R2 was computed

design.inner_split: KFold(5, shuffle, random_state=seed) over pairs: crossfit_assay's split
design.units: x = predicted/sd, z = observed/sd = x + r; a fitted g gives r_hat = g(x) - x
design.lambda: per assay, the ridge lambda alt_baseline's outer GroupKFold chose for the position model in that assay's outer fold (results/alt_baseline.json), used for every position-containing model, real and null
design.backfit: alternate g and position to max change <= 0.0001 sd or 200 iterations
design.metric: epsceil.baseline.r2_resid_var, out of fold, pooled over the assay's folds
design.null: 5 permutations per assay: residuals permuted among each fold's training pairs (alt_baseline._rng)
design.label_null: 5 permutations per assay: position labels permuted among each fold's training pairs, x and z untouched; the null of D42
design.polynomials: linear/quadratic/cubic are references, not constrained monotone
